one_line: One short label per activity in use, then fan out the full kit with its price.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down laminated autumn tree sheet; a small child's hands press green play-dough onto empty leaves. A kit-name badge, "ערכת סתיו", sits at lower left for under a second. 0:02 label: "מעיכה על עלים". No speech, no face.
q1_hook.why: A colourful hands-on action from the first frame puts the product in use at once (S1, E1), with the kit name as a brief badge (H3). But it names no audience or benefit (against H2, T3), there is no voice (H4), and the badge sits low (T4).

beats.what: Hands press dough leaves onto a tree sheet; badge, then "מעיכה על עלים"
beats.why: Product in use with the kit name

beats.what: A sheet of dough leaves, a die at its edge; label "לגלות את העלים עם קובייה" to 0:05
beats.why: Second game; the colours are the draw

beats.what: Label "צורות- גזירה והתאמה"; scissors, glue, shapes placed on a snail sheet
beats.why: Cut, glue, finished snail gives a mini sequence

beats.what: Label "אוספים עלים לפי מספרים"; dough pressed on numbered leaves, cut-out leaves
beats.why: A counting activity, same hands-on look

beats.what: Label "התאמת כמות לספרה"; number cards beside quantity cards on a board
beats.why: Shows the cards, with no child in frame

beats.what: Cards in a wooden bowl, leaf cut-outs, coloured stones spelling a word; no label
Pan over a fanned stack of pages; price text 0:35-0:37, none after
beats.why: Shows the whole kit and the price

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. Caption, last line: a DM ask, "רוצה לקבל את הערכה? שלחי לי הודעה בפרטי ואשלח לך אותה".
q2_flow.why: Each activity gets 3 to 9 s and a label, so the picture changes every few seconds (R3, E2). Ending on the full kit and price gives the last beat a purpose, but 0:30-0:34 has no label and the last 3 s no text, a tail (R1). 41 s is long for a catalogue (R2).

q3_cta.what: On screen 0:35-0:37: "ערכה לרכישה ב30 ש"ח". Nothing said, and no text 0:38-0:40. Caption: "מחיר הערכה: 30 ש״ח" and "רוצה לקבל את הערכה? שלחי לי הודעה בפרטי ואשלח לך אותה 💌".
q3_cta.why: One action, a DM, with the price given twice and a full contents list (C1, S3), after the activities are shown (C6). But the video text says "for purchase" without how; the how is in the caption only, and the text is off screen for the last 3 s.

q4_shown.what: A child's hands doing five activities, 0:00-0:29 (dough leaves, a die game, a shape-matching snail, number leaves, number cards); cards, leaf cut-outs and stone letters 0:30-0:34; a fanned stack of the pages with the price 0:35-0:40. No face.
q4_shown.why: About five of the 12 pages are shown in use, each with a short label, so a buyer can judge the range (R3, S4). The full stack and the price arrive last (S3, C7). No parent or teacher vouches for it, so the hands are the only proof (S6).

q5_edit.what: About 10 shots in 41 s (about 4 s each; the first pass counted 9 cuts), straight cuts to a new activity, static top-down camera, one pan at the end. Blue labels 0:02-0:10, 0:18-0:21, 0:27-0:29; price text 0:35-0:37. No speech.
q5_edit.why: A cut to a new activity every 4 to 9 s keeps the picture changing (E2, R3). Short labels let a muted viewer follow (E4, T2), but nothing audible carries the message (E4). It ends with 3 s of the stack and no text, a tail (R1, E8).

q6_topic.what: A priced autumn printable kit of 12 activity pages for gan-age children; it serves parents and teachers who want ready seasonal activities.
q6_topic.why: A seasonal need with a ready answer (K7), and the kit is shown in use rather than described (K5). The mood is calm with no peak and no story, so it reads as a catalogue (K1, K2). The contents list lives in the caption.

q7_filmed.what: Static top-down shots of a warm wooden table and laminated sheets, a child's hands and arms entering from the edges, in daylight; a board for number cards; a white table for stone letters; a handheld pan over the stack at the end.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands on a table is a clean, native, product-first view (F5, S4, H8). The sheets fill the frame (F4), but the cards on the board at 0:27-0:29 are small. The labels sit at about 74 to 83 percent down, inside the bottom 35% (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00 badge "ערכת סתיו" at lower left. Blue outlined labels, mostly 74 to 83 percent down: "מעיכה על עלים" (0:02), "לגלות את העלים עם קובייה" (0:03-0:05), "צורות- גזירה והתאמה" (0:09-0:10), "אוספים עלים לפי מספרים" (0:18-0:21), "התאמת כמות לספרה" (0:27-0:29). Pink text, cyan outline, 0:35-0:37: "ערכה לרכישה ב30 ש"ח". No text 0:11-0:17 or 0:38-0:40.
q8_text.caption: "🍂 מה כוללת ערכת הסתיו? 🤎". About 137 words: a question, a 12-item list of pages, a line on use, the price, a DM ask, 4 hashtags (#פעילותלילדים #גןילדים #יצירהעםילדים #יצירה). No disclosure.
q8_text.why: Short labels name each activity, so a muted viewer can follow (T1, T2). They sit in the lower third and are gone for stretches of 2 to 7 s (T4). The caption opens with a clear question and lists contents in search words (T7), while the price comes late and stays only 3 s (S3).

weak_points: No voice, face or trust cue; no benefit or audience in the first 3 s; price shown only 3 s; no way to buy on screen; 0:30-0:34 unlabelled; labels low in the frame; no text in the last 3 s.
lumebook_takeaway: Film each page type of the book top-down with a short label, 3 to 5 s each; end on the fanned pages with the full price and one DM ask.
not_verified: Speech: the transcript is garbled, so there is no usable speech; music cannot be told. Whether the kit is a file or printed pages (the caption says she will send it). The child's age. Corrections: the price text runs 0:35-0:37 and the last 3 s carry no text; the kit badge shows at 0:00 only.
